thread:
kai: Cutting RC v2.7.0-rc.1 for service-core. Artifact gh:ri/core@sha:abc123. Requesting promo today 16:00 PT if green canaries.

deploy-bot: rc created by kai — canary group: core-canary-1. CI: all checks passed. Preview link: https://ci.redwood/abc123

maria: noted. any infra/migration work going on?

kai: yes — background schema migration `add_orders_idx` kicked off in staging ~15:45 PT. It's an online index on orders table, long-running. Might still be running at 16:00.

sam: that's risky to promote into while migration active. Could amplify write latency and cause timeouts. What's the fallback if we see issues?

lina: ops: if migration still running at promo time we should either delay or pin to v2.6.4. We can also use the feature gate to keep risky paths off.

sheriff: +1 to pin if migration impacts latency. What's the rollback runbook if we need to abort?

kai: rollback plan (short):
1) flip traffic back to previous artifact
2) scale down new canaries
3) re-pin artifact to previous sha and restart deployments
Runbook snippet:
```
# rollback to previous pinned artifact
deploybot promote --artifact gh:ri/core@sha:prev999 --env prod --tag rollback
kubectl rollout restart deployment/core --namespace prod
```

maria: can we do a soft promo first? start 5% traffic for 15m, observe. We have traffic-splitting policy.

deploy-bot: promo command preview:
```
deploybot promote --artifact gh:ri/core@sha:abc123 --env prod --traffic 5
```

kai: planned cadence: 16:00 start -> 5% for 30m observe -> 50% 30m -> 100%. If migration still in progress at 16:00 we hold.

sam: who owns monitoring during the hold? I'll watch service latency and error rates. @lina pls watch DB migration progress and QPS.

lina: on it. I can intervene but pausing a running online index isn't trivial; pause/resume takes a few minutes and has risk.

maria: decision criteria: proceed only if 1) migration finished OR 2) migration <20% and 5% canary passes for 15m. Otherwise pin to prev and reschedule.

sheriff: gate set: abort if any 500s or P95 latency > 1.5x baseline during 5% hold. Acknowledge.

kai: release notes draft for RC:
- core: tokenizer perf improvements
- fix: request header edge-case causing malformed logs
- known: background index `add_orders_idx` running in staging — monitor during promo

maria: looks good. please paste this into release-notes channel after promo.

deploy-bot: promo window requested by kai at 16:00 PT. Waiting for manual confirm: `deploybot approve promo`

kai: approving now. `deploybot approve promo --thread 1767123456`

deploy-bot: Promo approved by kai. Reminder: manual hold if migration not finished.

lina: migration progress: 72% (ETA ~12m). I'll call hold if still >90% at 16:00.

sam: canaries starting 16:00 -> 5% traffic. I'm watching dashboards (latency, errors, DB QPS).

sam: canary 5% after 10m: no errors, latency +5% vs baseline. nothing alarming.

lina: migration completed at 16:10.

maria: proceed to 50%.

deploy-bot: ramping to 50% as requested by maria.

sam: 50% hold: 20m — p95 stable, error rate unchanged.

kai: proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: ramping to 100% — promotion complete. artifact gh:ri/core@sha:abc123 is now live in prod.

maria: thanks all. I'll update release notes and tag the artifact in the repo.

sheriff: ending sheriff watch. If any regression appears file incident and ping oncall. :white_check_mark:

kai: good job team.
